integrity: Two characteristic-distinct eight-element examples have directly verified ideal products. Proof applies without reliance on those finite checks. The motivating source was inspected in accessible HTML full text.
scientific_limitations: Full result is restricted to finite commutative unital local rings with square-zero maximal ideal. No claim about general rings or about independent verification. Gaussian subspace counting and the standard radical/subspace correspondence are acknowledged prior tools.
title: Square-zero local rings exhibit a unique nonfield collision with the field ideal-product probability
